title: Apply primary Grail tag AppID from host group
description: Every 12h: discovers host groups (metrics, classic entity API, Smartscape) named <number>_..., and ensures an ingest-enrichment rule sets primary_tags.AppID=<number>. Non-matching groups are skipped.

get_host_groups.name: get_host_groups

input.query:
timeseries c = count(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{dt.host_group.id}, from:now()-24h, interval:1h
| filter isNotNull(dt.host_group.id)
| fields dt.host_group.id

get_host_groups.description: Source 1 (metrics): distinct dt.host_group.id on host metrics, last 24h

list_nodes_with_appid.name: list_nodes_with_appid

input.query:
smartscapeNodes "*", from:now()-24h
| filter isNotNull(primary_tags.AppID)
| fields id, type, name, primary_tags.AppID
| sort primary_tags.AppID, type, name
| limit 1000

list_nodes_with_appid.description: Final check: Smartscape nodes that carry the primary Grail tag AppID

get_host_groups_classic.name: get_host_groups_classic
get_host_groups_classic.description: Source 2 (classic entity API): type(HOST_GROUP). Never fails the workflow; returns an error note if the API/scope is unavailable.

enrich_hosts_and_processes.name: enrich_hosts_and_processes
enrich_hosts_and_processes.description: Union host groups from metrics, classic entity API and Smartscape; per host group ensure environment-scope enrichment rule setting primary_tags.AppID to the number before the first underscore
